falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A new all-time high would invalidate the 'bottom_2024_aug' pattern match, as that pattern resolved with lower lows and capitulation; new highs instead indicate the correction already ended and this was not a bottoming formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained sub-12 VIX indicates complacency and risk-on stability, directly contradicting a bottoming thesis which requires elevated or spiking fear; would prove the 42 blowoff score was misreading distribution as capitulation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 5+ days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-quality bid driving rates sharply lower with sustained duration would signal recession/deep slowdown, invalidating a 'bottom' call by showing the macro deterioration that typically follows such patterns, not precedes recovery

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
